title: The Last Failsafe
description: Nadia has designed a simple backup circuit in case a critical town mechanism fails.
completion_text: Nadia admits that asking someone to help does not make her work any less reliable.

stages.title: The Last Failsafe
stages.lead: Craft redstone repeaters and review Nadia's backup plan.
notes: A personal request from Nadia. The quest is only offered through their friendship dialogue.

objectives.description: Discuss how to test the failsafe with Nadia.
